name: report
description: 全流程重型研报：19 Agent 闭环交付 (含欺诈检测、三市场适配、双HITL、独立QA)
prompt: 针对 {{target}} 执行全流程重型研报 (v1.5.0, 19-agent, mode={{mode|institutional}})。orchestrator 按 task_type→tier 硬路由并维护 pipeline-state.json。流程: 0. screen (ticker-resolver消歧+GICS/申万+profitable_flag+is_conglomerate/segments+valuation_engine_hint，restatement_policy: 实时as-restated/回测as-reported)；1. financial-researcher 解析到extracted/ + Footnote Slicer建footnotes_focus/_footnote_index.csv(含Cross-Reference Expansion Fetching) + evidence-locker经inbox队列登记FN；2. fraud-screener 定量(M-Score/Z-Score/Sloan/现金债悖论)+定性(附注聚焦窗口)+治理红旗；3. financial-analyst 多文档对账，gate-keeper 收 Pre-Valuation HITL (institutional需APPROVED；batch-autonomous记AUTO_PASSED_WITH_WARNINGS继续)；4. industry-peer-analyst peer交叉 + macro归因 + ESG筛查，sentiment旁路；5. valuation-expert按valuation_routing.yaml选引擎(集团SOTP分部加总)(DCF/Multiples/金融旁路/PB-ROE/DDM/rNPV，禁对金融强算FCFF；SBC/租赁双列调整；discount_currency+CRP硬化+T=0即期单点转换) + scenario三情景 + visualization活表；6. portfolio仓位；7. adversarial-skeptic红队(max2轮熔断，超限转Unresolved定tier并触发Haircut联动) + compliance措辞审 + judge三方比对，gate-keeper收Pre-Publication(SIGNED_OFF)并写webhook_payload.json异步推送；8. report-writer出FN合规研报到workspace/reports/(含Challenge Resolution + Unresolved Discrepancies + disclaimer)。black-account-checker仅用户另附私有流水时旁路调用(先PII脱敏)。T1失败cascade到T2。
